About HMPV Virus 

• Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a virus that causes mild infections like a common cold.

• It was first identified in 2001 and is related to viruses like respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), measles, and mumps.

• HMPV can cause infections in the nose, https://t.co/Hpfn2iwSzf

nodes.author: pmfias
nodes.text:
How HMPV Spreads? 

• HMPV spreads through direct contact with someone who has it or from touching things contaminated with the virus. For instance:
➢ Coughing and sneezing.
➢ Shaking hands, hugging or kissing.
➢ Touching surfaces or objects like phones, door handles, https://t.co/NCUakeQh8x

nodes.author: pmfias
nodes.text:
Prevention

• Wash hands frequently with soap and water.
• Avoid close contact with infected people.
• Avoid touching your face.
• Wear a mask if infected.
• People with lung conditions should be extra cautious.

Can HMPV Virus Trigger a Health Concern for India?

• Indian health authorities are closely monitoring the situation, but there is currently no significant increase in respiratory outbreaks in India. 

• Based on current data from ICMR and the Integrated Disease Surveillance https://t.co/0naNViyZ5H
